BiblicalUsage: Zelek the Ammonite was one of David's mighty men, the armourbearer to Joab. He is named in both lists of the thirty, a foreigner who fought for Israel's king. An Ammonite carrying Joab's armour is a reminder that David's army was wider than Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zelek shows that God's king gathers men from beyond the border — an Ammonite among the mighty men. Faithfulness is not a matter of birthplace.
